candidates.name: pembrolizumab-induced scleroderma
support_spans: The edema appeared 5 days after the patient's 8th cycle of chemotherapy and evolved into sclerotic plaques.
Examination revealed ill-defined, erythematoedematous plaques symmetrically distributed along the shins, with areas of induration.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination results are consistent with scleroderma, a known side effect of pembrolizumab.

candidates.name: pemetrexed-induced dermatitis
support_spans: The patient had received 4 cycles of chemotherapy with carboplatin, pemetrexed, and pembrolizumab for progressive disease and was currently in maintenance with pemetrexed-pembrolizumab.
Examination revealed ill-defined, erythematoedematous plaques symmetrically distributed along the shins, with areas of induration.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination results are consistent with dermatitis, a known side effect of pemetrexed.

candidates.name: pembrolizumab-induced autoimmune disease
support_spans: The edema appeared 5 days after the patient's 8th cycle of chemotherapy and evolved into sclerotic plaques.
Pathology: Shows normal-appearing epidermis, thickened dermal collagen with activated fibroblasts, and lymphocytic perivascular infiltration.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and pathology results are consistent with an autoimmune disease, a known mechanism of pembrolizumab.

candidates.name: carboplatin-induced vascular damage
support_spans: The patient had received 4 cycles of chemotherapy with carboplatin, pemetrexed, and pembrolizumab for progressive disease
contradict_spans: Venous Doppler ultrasonography of legs showed no evidence of deep vein thrombosis.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination results are not consistent with vascular damage, but carboplatin is known to cause vascular damage.
